universities.name: Heidelberg University
mfa_steps: Open the {portal} and sign in with your Uni ID.
Type a name, for example Laptop, and click "Weiter".
Take a screenshot of the QR code ({shot}) and drop or paste it here.{secret}
Click "Weiter", then "Testen". Type this code and click "Absenden".{code}
universities.notes: Tested end to end, see docs/e2e.md. The OTP form comes after the password form.

universities.name: ETH Zurich (staff)
universities.notes: Students: ethz-students (authgroup "student-net", username_suffix "@student-net.ethz.ch"). The second factor is set up at www.password.ethz.ch ("Automatic OTP Registration").

universities.name: ETH Zurich (students)
universities.notes: Staff: ethz. The second factor is set up at www.password.ethz.ch ("Automatic OTP Registration").

universities.name: University of Bremen
universities.notes: Without 2FA the second field stays empty, which uni-vpn cannot send yet. Checked 2026-10-19: the gateway lists two groups; Tunnel-All-Traffic (its default) reaches the library's e-books, Tunnel-Uni-Bremen only the campus.

universities.name: University of Marburg (staff)
universities.notes: Students: marburg-students. Checked 2026-10-19: app tokens give 8-digit HMAC-SHA512 codes; Google and Microsoft Authenticator cannot make them, the Uni-Marburg app and 2FAS can.

universities.name: University of Marburg (students)
universities.notes: Staff: marburg. Checked 2026-10-19: app tokens give 8-digit HMAC-SHA512 codes; Google and Microsoft Authenticator cannot make them, the Uni-Marburg app and 2FAS can.

universities.name: Stanford University
universities.notes: The default group CardinalKey is SAML; the group Stanford-Full is a password form with Duo and the full tunnel the university requires for restricted library resources.

universities.name: University of Hong Kong (staff)
mfa_steps: Open the {portal} and sign in. Add a sign-in method: the authenticator app, then the option to use a different authenticator app.
Take a screenshot of the QR code ({shot}) and drop or paste it here.{secret}
Go to the next page and type this code there.{code}
If the line with "Change" at the top of the page shows a phone number, click "Change", choose "App based authentication or hardware token - code" and click "Confirm".
universities.notes: Profile from the university's documentation, not tested. Checked 2026-10-19: after the password the gateway asks for a Microsoft one-time code; the code generator is added as "a different authenticator app" in Microsoft's security info. Students: hku-students.

universities.notes: Staff: hku (uid@hku.hk). Steps as hku.

universities.name: University of Granada
mfa_steps: Open the {portal} and sign in. Choose "Doble Factor Autenticación para Servicios TIC UGR" and click "Generar nuevo token".
Take a screenshot of the QR code ({shot}) and drop or paste it here. Also scan it with the app on your phone.{secret}
universities.notes: Profile from the university's documentation, not tested. User name is the full address cuenta@ugr.es. Checked 2026-10-18: the gateway asks for a one-time code in its own field; the code generator is added under "Doble Factor Autenticación para Servicios TIC UGR" in the Oficina Virtual.

universities.name: Westphalian University of Applied Sciences
mfa_steps: Open the {portal} and sign in without @w-hs.de; if you already have a token, enter a code from it. Click "Token ausrollen" on the left, then "Token ausrollen" again below (not "Neuen Token ausrollen").
Take a screenshot of the QR code ({shot}) and drop or paste it here. Also scan it with the app on your phone.{secret}
universities.notes: Profile from the university's documentation, not tested. Checked 2026-10-19: the gateway lists Sec-Groups (its default), Secure-RZ, VPN+MFA and zAlle; the guide signs in with VPN+MFA and a second password. User name without @w-hs.de. The token page opens only on campus or over the VPN.
